purpose: B4 memory measurements under enforced RP-4G and RP-8G cgroups at 1M, 10M and 100M events. The 100M run is the binding B4 acceptance run; the 1M/10M profile runs complete the scale profile set.

measurement.mechanism: systemd-run --user --scope with MemoryMax and MemorySwapMax=0; per-batch VmRSS/VmHWM from /proc/self/status; cgroup memory.peak from the scope
measurement.slope_rule: least-squares slope of VmRSS bytes against events over the final decile of batch samples; MiB per million events

1M_RP4G.final_decile_note: only 2 samples in the final decile; slope is allocator noise, not a trend

1M_RP8G.final_decile_note: only 2 samples in the final decile; slope is allocator noise, not a trend

comparison.100m_note: The 100M cgroup peak equals the 4G limit because 13.4GB of corpus page cache is charged to the scope; the process peak is 133.0 MiB. The cgroup did not OOM and the run exited 0.
comparison.scale_note: Peak process memory grows 43.4 MiB (1M) -> 49.4 MiB (10M) -> 133.0 MiB (100M), sublinear in events (100x events, 3.1x peak). The 100M final-decile slope is 0.827 MiB/M, below the 1 MiB/M target but higher than the 0.014 MiB/M 10M slope; active state remains bounded and purged.

acceptance_note: Closes the B4 cgroup/profile blocker for #12 and supplies B4 profile evidence for #13. B4 is a memory check, not a p90 latency check.
